sources.title: Piracy monthly report October 2024
sources.text: While underway, 10 perpetrators armed with knives were sighted in the engine room of the ship. The alarm was raised and crew mustered to conduct a search onboard the ship. No perpetrators were found and some engine spare parts were stolen. All crew members were accounted for without injury. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS West.
